ja: • 世代を超えて人気のあるミュウツーがポケモンプラモコレクションに登場。
• ひじ、首、手首、足首、しっぽが可動。
• しっぽを上げると、連動して右手を上げるぞ。
• 専用台座が付属。ポージングがカッコよく決まる。
en: • Mewtwo, which is popular across generations, is now available in the Pokemon plastic model collection.
• Elbows, neck, wrists, ankles, and tail are movable.
• When you raise your tail, it will also raise its right hand.
• A special pedestal is included. The pose looks cool.
